$description: Data visualization colors (library plan wave 1, foundation dataviz-colors): categorical, sequential, diverging, status and alert scales for charts, from existing roles and palette shades only (no new colors). utils/dataviz.js names them; [data-plx-dataviz="<scale>-<step>"] (system/dataviz.css) applies one as the element’s data color.

dataviz-categorical-1.$description: Categorical color 1 of 6: the data color blue. Unrelated series take the categorical colors in this order.

dataviz-categorical-2.$description: Categorical color 2 of 6: the data color green. Unrelated series take the categorical colors in this order.

dataviz-categorical-3.$description: Categorical color 3 of 6: the data color purple. Unrelated series take the categorical colors in this order.

dataviz-categorical-4.$description: Categorical color 4 of 6: the data color red. Unrelated series take the categorical colors in this order.

dataviz-categorical-5.$description: Categorical color 5 of 6: the data color brown. Unrelated series take the categorical colors in this order.

dataviz-categorical-6.$description: Categorical color 6 of 6: the data color gray. Unrelated series take the categorical colors in this order.

dataviz-sequential-1.$description: Sequential step 1 of 7 (one hue, blue 100): ordered values, the low end lightest.

dataviz-sequential-2.$description: Sequential step 2 of 7 (one hue, blue 200): ordered values, the low end lightest.

dataviz-sequential-3.$description: Sequential step 3 of 7 (one hue, blue 300): ordered values, the low end lightest.

dataviz-sequential-4.$description: Sequential step 4 of 7 (one hue, blue 400): ordered values, the low end lightest.

dataviz-sequential-5.$description: Sequential step 5 of 7 (one hue, blue 600): ordered values, the low end lightest.

dataviz-sequential-6.$description: Sequential step 6 of 7 (one hue, blue 700): ordered values, the low end lightest.

dataviz-sequential-7.$description: Sequential step 7 of 7 (one hue, blue 900): ordered values, the low end lightest.

dataviz-diverging-1.$description: Diverging step 1 of 7 (red 800): below the midpoint, the far end darkest.

dataviz-diverging-2.$description: Diverging step 2 of 7 (red 500): below the midpoint, the far end darkest.

dataviz-diverging-3.$description: Diverging step 3 of 7 (red 200): below the midpoint, the far end darkest.

dataviz-diverging-4.$description: Diverging step 4 of 7 (gray 200): the neutral midpoint.

dataviz-diverging-5.$description: Diverging step 5 of 7 (blue 200): above the midpoint, the far end darkest.

dataviz-diverging-6.$description: Diverging step 6 of 7 (blue 400): above the midpoint, the far end darkest.

dataviz-diverging-7.$description: Diverging step 7 of 7 (blue 700): above the midpoint, the far end darkest.

dataviz-status-positive.$description: Status for charts: positive (the theme’s success mark). Only where the data is a status, never for ordinary series.

dataviz-status-caution.$description: Status for charts: caution (the theme’s warning mark). Only where the data is a status, never for ordinary series.

dataviz-status-negative.$description: Status for charts: negative (the theme’s danger mark). Only where the data is a status, never for ordinary series.

dataviz-status-informative.$description: Status for charts: informative (the theme’s info mark). Only where the data is a status, never for ordinary series.

dataviz-status-neutral.$description: Status for charts: neutral (the theme’s neutral mark). Only where the data is a status, never for ordinary series.

dataviz-alert-warning.$description: A threshold line or band a value should not cross (warning).

dataviz-alert-critical.$description: A threshold a value must not cross, or an alert on a point (critical).

dataviz-grid-line.$description: The chart grid and axis lines.

dataviz-label.$description: Axis labels, tick values and the legend.
